bayts.text: My God has guarded my every horizon, filling it with granted wishes, and forever He has freed my hand from having to say "give me".
He (Allah) who never ceases to be my strength and my might has guided the learned and the Saints (al-awliyāʾ) to me.
My ode has surpassed the odes of the noble, and forever it leads to me the most excellent of wishes.
My gift puts to shame every king who set himself up as a rival, and the King (Allah) has abased him.
God has erased, in my favour, the advance of the Nazarenes (the Christian colonisers), by "There is no god but God".
